title: POST/PUT /reference/* routes missing from csrf.should_skip: a session-carrying referee gets 403 JSON on every answer save and resend
evidence: router.gleam:80 "use <- csrf.validate(req, ctx.config.secret_key)"; router.gleam:968-972 "http.Post, ["reference", token, "answer"] -> form_handler.handle_answer_post(req, ctx.config, token)" / "http.Put, ["reference", token, "answer"] -> form_handler.handle_answer_put(req, ctx.config, token)" / "http.Post, ["reference", token, "resend"] -> form_handler.handle_resend(req, ctx.config, token)"; csrf.gleam:41-48 "case req.method { http.Get | http.Head | http.Options -> handler() _ -> { let path = wisp.path_segments(req) case should_skip(path) { True -> handler() False -> validate_token(req, secret_key, handler)"; csrf.gleam:100-102 "["dsar", _] -> True / ["erase", _] -> True / _ -> False" (no reference arm); csrf.gleam:116-124 "Ok(access_token) -> { let expected = generate_token(secret_key, access_token) case request.get_header(req, "x-csrf-token") { ... Error(_) -> csrf_error_response() }"
detail: The reference form carries no CSRF token (form_question_pages hidden fields are only _question/_website/_form_loaded_at/_focus_seconds; reference_form.js sends no x-csrf-token header), and should_skip lacks a /reference arm. A referee holding an rt_session cookie (e.g. a landlord who is also a referee) gets a 403 JSON dead end on every answer POST/PUT and resend - the first-class no-JS path breaks with no branded page.
recommended_fix: Add ["reference", ..] -> True to csrf.should_skip next to the dsar/erase arms, matching the sibling capability-token routes, so POST/PUT /reference/* skip the session HMAC check.
